DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座について、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給料を入金したと会社から聞いたのに、残高が増えていません。自分で現金を入れないと表示されないんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社が給料を入金したと言うのに残高が増えないと説明し、自分で現金を入れる必要があるのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company says it deposited my salary, but my balance hasn't increased. Do I have to deposit cash myself for it to appear?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your balance has not increased despite the company saying it paid your salary, and ask whether you need to deposit cash yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社からの振込と、ご自身の現金入金は別の手続きです。会社へ伝えた口座と、今見ている口座は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A transfer from your company and your own cash deposit are separate procedures. Is the account you gave the company the same as the one you're looking at now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯には二つ口座があります。今開いていたのは生活費用で、会社にはもう一つの口座を伝えたはずです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯に二つの口座があり、表示中は生活費用で会社には別の口座を知らせたはずだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have two accounts on my phone. The one I had open is for living expenses, and I believe I gave the company the other account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have two accounts on your phone, the displayed one is for living expenses, and you believe you gave the company another account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込先として伝えた控えと、表示している口座を照合してください。確認したいのは、どの取引でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please compare your record of the account details you provided with the account displayed. Which transaction would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社へ送った口座の控えを見つけました。番号の末尾が違います。給与用のほうを開いて、今月の振込だけ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ送った控えと表示中の口座の番号末尾が違うと伝え、給与用口座の今月の振込を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found the account details I sent the company. The last digits are different. I'd like to open the salary account and check just this month's transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the final account-number digits on the record sent to the company differ from the displayed account, and you want to check this month's transfer in the salary account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取引明細の確認方法をご案内します。暗証番号やログインの情報は、こちらへ読み上げず、ご自身で入力してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain how to check your transaction details. Please enter your PIN and login information yourself without reading them out to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 給与用を開いたら、会社名の明細がありました。残高だけだと出金も混ざるので、振込額を明細で見ればいいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与用口座に会社名の明細があったと伝え、残高だけでなく一件の振込額を見ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I opened the salary account, there was a transaction showing the company name. Since the balance also reflects withdrawals, I should look at the transfer amount in the transaction details, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you found a transaction with the company name in the salary account, and confirm you should look at the individual transfer amount rather than only the balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。残高と一件ごとの入出金額は別です。明細の日付、振込元、金額を確認し、不明点があれば照会してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The balance and individual deposit or withdrawal amounts are different. Check the date, sender, and amount in the details, and make an inquiry if anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社へ伝えた口座に切り替え、日付と会社名と金額を確認します。見つからないと決めつけて現金を入れなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社へ知らせた口座に切り替えて日付、会社名、金額を確認し、見つからないと思い込んで現金を入れずに済んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll switch to the account I gave the company and check the date, company name, and amount. I'm glad I didn't assume it was missing and deposit cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will switch to the account given to the company, check the date, company name, and amount, and are glad you avoided depositing cash based on an assumption that the payment was missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する口座が整理できましたね。必要な明細を確認してから操作を終えてください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've clarified which account to check. Please check the necessary details before ending your session. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布を忘れて携帯だけ持ってきました。いつもの支払いアプリが開かないのですが、ここで払う方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布を忘れ支払いアプリも開けないと説明し、店で使える支払方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot my wallet and only brought my phone. My usual payment app won't open. Is there any way I can pay here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot your wallet and cannot open your payment app, and ask which payment methods the store accepts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場で使える決済方法をご案内します。アプリは起動しないのですか、それとも支払い画面だけが出ませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll explain the payment methods accepted in this section. Does the app fail to start, or is it only the payment screen that doesn't appear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 起動するとログインが必要と出ます。通信もうまくいきません。店でアプリの設定まで直せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ログインが必要と表示され通信もうまくいかないと伝え、店でアプリの設定まで直せると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: When it starts, it says I need to log in. The connection isn't working well, either. I thought the store could even fix the app settings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it asks you to log in and the connection is poor, and explain that you thought the store could fix the app settings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: アプリのログインは提供元の案内で確認してください。別の決済手段や、持っている現金はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the app provider's instructions for logging in. Do you have another payment method or any cash with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ポケットに少し現金がありました。全部は買えないので、今日必要な牛乳とパンだけに減らしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少し現金が見つかったが全部は買えないと伝え、今日必要な牛乳とパンだけに減らしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found a little cash in my pocket. I can't buy everything, so I'd like to cut it down to just the milk and bread I need today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found a little cash but cannot buy everything, and ask to reduce the purchase to the milk and bread needed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計前の商品なら、不要なものを職員へお渡しください。必要な品だけで金額を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the items haven't been paid for yet, please hand unwanted ones to a staff member. We can check the amount for just what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二つだけにします。袋も買うと予算を超えるかもしれないので、折り畳みバッグに入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二品だけにすると伝え、袋代で予算を超える可能性があるため自分のバッグを使いたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take just these two. Buying a bag might put me over budget, so I'd like to use my folding bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take only two items and want to use your own bag because a bag charge may exceed your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちのバッグをご利用ください。二点の金額をレジで確かめてから、支払いを進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the bag you brought. Let's check the price of the two items at the register before proceeding with payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: アプリは帰宅後に確認します。今は二点だけの合計を見て、足りる現金で払います。ほかの商品はこちらへ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: アプリは帰宅後に確認し、二品の合計を見て現金で払い、ほかの商品は職員に返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the app after I get home. For now, I'll check the total for just the two items and pay with the cash I have enough of. I'll hand the other products back here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the app after going home, check the two-item total and pay in cash, and return the other products to staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お預かりした商品はこちらで戻します。バッグへ入れてお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll put the items you've handed us back. Please put your purchases in your bag and take them with you. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園内で何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you looking for something in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供がトイレに行きたがっています。水も飲みたいと言っているので、両方の場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供のトイレと飲み水の場所を尋ね、両方の案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child wants to use the toilet and says they want some water, too. Please tell me where both are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the toilets and drinking water are for your child, requesting directions to both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在地からの案内を確認します。お子さんは今、ご一緒ですか。トイレを先に案内してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the directions from here. Is your child with you now? May I show you the toilet first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣にいます。トイレを先にお願いします。水を探す間、子供をここで待たせようかと思いましたが、一緒に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供は隣にいると答え、トイレを先に案内してもらい、子供を置いて水を探さず一緒に行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're beside me. The toilet first, please. I considered leaving my child here while I looked for water, but we'll go together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your child is beside you, ask for toilet directions first, and say you will go together rather than leave your child to look for water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: トイレへは、案内所を背に右の舗装通路を進み、青い「トイレ」の表示を目印にしてください。お子さんと一緒に移動できます。水飲み場は地図にありますが、今使えるかはまだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the toilet, stand with your back to the information center and follow the paved path to your right, using the blue 'Toilet' sign as your landmark. You can go together with your child. The drinking fountain is on the map, but we haven't confirmed whether it's usable now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 地図に印があれば必ず使えるわけではないんですね。今使えるかわからなければ、持っている飲み物を先に飲ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図に水飲み場の印があっても利用できるとは限らないと確認し、不明なら持参した飲み物を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So a symbol on the map doesn't guarantee it can be used. If we don't know whether it's working, I'll give my child the drink I brought first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that a drinking-fountain symbol on the map does not guarantee availability, and say you will use your own drink if it is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の案内や閉鎖表示をご確認ください。水が出ない設備を無理に操作する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the signs on site and any closure notices. There's no need to force equipment that isn't dispensing water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供と飲み物を分けられるので、水飲み場を探して遠回りはしません。トイレまで、段差を避ける道も地図で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参した飲み物を分けられるので遠回りはせず、トイレまで段差を避ける道を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can share my drink with my child, so we won't take a detour to find the fountain. I'd also like to see a step-free route to the toilet on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can share the drink you brought and will not take a detour, and want to check a step-free route to the toilet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内した右の舗装通路は、この地図では段差のない経路です。青いトイレ表示までお子さんと一緒に進んでください。現地で通行止めなどがあれば進まず、こちらへお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The paved path to the right that I described is shown as step-free on this map. Please follow it with your child to the blue toilet sign. If there's a closure or similar restriction on site, don't continue; let us know here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子供と一緒に、通路の表示を見ながらトイレへ行きます。飲み物は持参分を使い、水飲み場は利用できるとわかった時だけ使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子供と一緒に通路表示を見ながらトイレへ行き、持参飲料を使って水飲み場は利用可否が分かった時だけ使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go to the toilet with my child, following the path signs. We'll use the drink we brought and only use the fountain once we know it's available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will go to the toilet with your child while following the path signs, use your own drink, and use the fountain only when its availability is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お子さんと離れずに移動してください。わからなくなったらまたお尋ねください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please stay together with your child as you move. Ask again if you get confused. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動について、何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕張から出かける切符を買いたいです。昔の地図にある夕張駅から乗るつもりですが、その行き方でいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕張から出かける切符を買いたいと伝え、古い地図の駅から乗る想定でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy a ticket for a trip from Yubari. I'm planning to board at Yubari Station on this old map. Is that the right way to go?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to buy a ticket for travel from Yubari and ask whether planning to board at the station on an old map is appropriate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旧夕張駅から列車に乗る前提では調べられません。現在使える交通と、列車に乗る駅を分けて確認しましょう。目的地はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't plan on the assumption that you'll board a train at the former Yubari Station. Let's check the transport currently available separately from the station where you can board a train. Where is your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この住所です。駅名だけで検索していました。まず目的地までの今の経路を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地の住所を示し、駅名だけで検索せず現在の経路を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this address. I was searching only by station name. I'd like to first check the current route to my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your destination address and say you want to check the current route rather than search only by station name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。鉄道を利用する区間と、そこまでの移動を区別します。切符を買う前に出発日も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll distinguish the rail section from the journey to reach it. Let's also check your departure date before buying tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日出発ですが、帰りの日は決まっていません。最初から往復券にせず、行きの区間が決まってから買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明日出発で帰りは未定だと答え、往復券を先に買わず行きの区間が決まってから購入したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm leaving tomorrow, but haven't decided when I'll return. Rather than buy a return ticket right away, I'd like to buy once the outward section is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you leave tomorrow with no return date set, and want to confirm the outward section before buying rather than buy a return ticket first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望で調べましょう。移動手段ごとに支払い方法が違う場合があるので、一枚の切符で全部乗れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's search on that basis. Payment methods may differ by mode of transport, so one ticket won't necessarily cover the entire trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列車の切符だけで、駅へ向かう交通も払えると思っていました。それぞれどこで買うか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鉄道券で駅までの別交通も払えると思っていたと説明し、各区間の購入先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought the train ticket would also pay for the transport to the station. I'd like to check where to buy each one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the rail ticket covered the other transport to the station, and say you want to check where to buy tickets for each section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経路が決まったら、区間ごとの購入先と支払い方法を確認しましょう。便と料金は、出発日の交通事業者の案内で調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the route is established, let's check where to buy and how to pay for each section. Please check the transport operator's information for services and fares on your departure date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い駅を出発駅にせず、住所と日付で経路を調べます。行きの区間と購入先を確かめて、必要な切符だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い駅を出発地にせず住所と日付で調べ、行きの区間と購入先に合う必要な券だけ買うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't use the old station as my starting station. I'll search by address and date. I'll check the outward sections and where to buy, and purchase only the necessary tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will search by address and date without using the former station as the starting point, and buy only the tickets needed for the outward sections and their purchase locations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。新しい案内で出発前に再確認してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please recheck the latest information before departure. Thank you for your inquiry. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。予約の通知について、何をお確かめになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the appointment notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談の予約通知が二枚あります。新しい方に変更と書かれていて、予約が取り消されたのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約の通知が二枚あり、新しい通知の変更という記載が予約の取消しを意味するのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two notices for my consultation appointment. The newer one says 'change,' and I'm worried the appointment may have been canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have two consultation appointment notices and ask whether 'change' on the newer notice means cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚の予約番号と発行日を比べましょう。同じ予約の変更なのか、別の予約なのかを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the appointment numbers and issue dates on both. We'll check whether it's a change to the same appointment or a different appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は同じです。先に届いた紙は木曜十時で、後の紙は金曜十四時です。木曜に休みを取ったので、古い時間のまま来るつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の予約番号は同じで、木曜十時から金曜十四時へ変わっているが、木曜に休みを取って古い時刻に行くつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The numbers are the same. The first notice says Thursday at ten, and the later one says Friday at fourteen hundred. I took Thursday off, so I was planning to come at the old time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both notices have the same number and the appointment changed from Thursday at 10:00 to Friday at 14:00, but you took Thursday off and intended to attend at the old time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この予約番号の現在の記録は、金曜十四時です。相談自体が取り消されたのではなく、木曜の枠から変更されています。会場も二枚で同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current record for this appointment number is Friday at 14:00. The consultation itself hasn't been canceled; it has been moved from the Thursday slot. Is the venue the same on both notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い紙は別館、新しい紙は本館二階の相談室です。曜日だけ書き直して、会場の違いは見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧通知の別館と新通知の本館二階相談室は異なり、曜日だけ直して会場の変更を見落としたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The old paper says the annex, and the new one says the consultation room on the second floor of the main building. I only corrected the day and overlooked the different venue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the old notice's annex differs from the new notice's main-building second-floor consultation room, and you changed only the day and missed the venue change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の予約は金曜十四時、本館二階の相談室です。木曜の別館という古い予定を訂正してください。金曜のご都合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The current appointment is Friday at 14:00 in the consultation room on the second floor of the main building. Please correct the old plan of Thursday in the annex. Are you available on Friday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務先に休みの変更を相談します。まだ金曜に行けると確定していないので、来られない場合の連絡先も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先へ休みの変更を相談するため金曜の出席はまだ確定しておらず、行けない時の連絡先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my employer about changing my day off. I haven't confirmed I can come on Friday yet, so I'd also like to check whom to contact if I can't attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you must discuss changing your day off with your employer, so Friday attendance is not yet certain, and want to check whom to contact if you cannot come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい通知にある予約相談の連絡先へ、同じ予約番号でお知らせください。別の枠が空いているかは、その時に確認します。古い通知は見比べた記録として残して構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please contact the appointment consultation number on the new notice and give the same appointment number. We'll check then whether another slot is available. You may keep the old notice as a record for comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定表は金曜十四時、本館二階に直します。勤務先と調整し、行けない場合は新しい通知の連絡先へ予約番号を伝えて相談します。予約が全部なくなったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金曜十四時、本館二階へ予定を直し、勤務先との調整後に出席できなければ新通知の連絡先へ予約番号で相談し、予約全体の取消しとは捉えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll change my calendar to Friday at 14:00, second floor of the main building. I'll coordinate with my employer, and if I can't attend, I'll contact the details on the new notice with my appointment number to discuss it. I won't assume the whole appointment has disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will change your schedule to Friday at 14:00 on the main building's second floor, consult the contact on the new notice using the appointment number if work arrangements prevent attendance, and not regard the whole appointment as canceled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の日時と会場をご確認いただけました。ご都合が決まったら、新しい通知の案内でご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You've confirmed the current time and venue. Please contact us according to the new notice once you know your availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診のご相談で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your request for a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤の後、仕事中の眠気について相談したいです。睡眠時間をメモしましたが、合計だけで伝えてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤後の仕事中の眠気を相談したく、睡眠メモは合計時間だけで伝えてよいか迷っていると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: After working nights, I'd like advice about sleepiness at work. I've recorded my sleep, but I'm unsure whether to report just the total hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to discuss sleepiness at work after night shifts and are unsure whether to report only the total hours from your sleep notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 医療担当へ渡せるよう、メモの書き方を確認しましょう。「5時間」は、一度に続けて眠った時間ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check how the note is written so you can give it to the medical staff. Does 'five hours' mean one continuous period of sleep?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、10月1日は午前9時から12時までと、午後3時から5時までの二回です。合計だけ書いたので、続けて5時間と読まれるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 10月1日は午前9〜12時と午後3〜5時の二回で、連続5時間ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. On October 1, I slept twice: from nine to twelve in the morning and three to five in the afternoon. I only wrote the total, so it might be read as five continuous hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that on October 1 you slept from 09:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 17:00 in two periods, not five continuous hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初が3時間、次が2時間で、合計5時間ですね。二回の時刻を別の行に書きます。睡眠の長さが十分かどうかは医療担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's three hours first, then two hours, totaling five. We'll put the times of the two periods on separate lines. Please ask the medical staff whether that amount of sleep is sufficient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、5時間で足りるかを受付で決めてほしいのではありません。途中で起きたことと、仕事中に眠気を感じたことを別々に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付に十分な睡眠か判断してほしいのではなく、途中で起きたことと仕事中の眠気を別々に医療者へ伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'm not asking reception to decide whether five hours is enough. I want to tell the medical staff separately that I was awake between the sleep periods and felt sleepy at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are not asking reception to judge whether your sleep was sufficient, but want to tell medical staff separately about being awake between sleep periods and sleepiness at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 眠った時刻と眠気を感じた時刻を分けましょう。眠気は同じ日でしたか、それとも次の勤務でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's separate the times you slept from the time you felt sleepy. Was the sleepiness on the same day or at your next shift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の勤務で、10月2日の午前2時ごろです。眠った10月1日の欄にまとめず、別の日の出来事として書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 眠気は次の勤務の10月2日午前2時ごろで、10月1日の睡眠と別の行へ書いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the next shift, around two in the morning on October 2. Please write it as an event on a separate day rather than include it under October 1, when I slept.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the sleepiness was at the next shift around 02:00 on October 2, and ask for a separate line from the October 1 sleep record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 睡眠は10月1日に二回、眠気は10月2日午前2時ごろと分けました。睡眠中に何回も目が覚めたと書いたのではなく、二つの睡眠の間に起きていた、で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've separated the two sleep periods on October 1 and the sleepiness around 02:00 on October 2. To confirm, you were awake between two periods of sleep, rather than waking repeatedly during your sleep, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合っています。3時間と2時間の二回で、連続5時間ではありません。翌日の午前2時ごろの眠気も別の行になっています。このメモを医療担当へ渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 睡眠は3時間と2時間の二回で連続5時間ではなく、翌日の眠気も別の行になっていると確認し、メモを医療者へ渡したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Correct. It was two periods of three and two hours, not five continuous hours. The sleepiness around two the next morning is on a separate line, too. I'd like to give this note to the medical staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that sleep was in two periods of three and two hours, not five continuous hours, and the next day's sleepiness is on a separate line, and say you want to give the note to medical staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表記を確認できました。メモを医療担当へお渡しします。眠気の原因や仕事についての相談は担当にお伝えください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked the wording. I'll give the note to the medical staff. Please discuss the cause of your sleepiness and work-related concerns with them. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What can I help you with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩中に小さな袋を拾いました。中は開けていませんが、こちらへ届けてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩中に拾った小袋は開けていないと伝え、届けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a small bag while walking. I haven't opened it. May I hand it in here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have not opened the small bag found while walking, and ask to hand it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾った状況を伺います。場所と、拾った時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about how you found it. Please tell me the location and the time you picked it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園の外の歩道です。時計を見たのは家へ戻ってからなので、その時刻を拾った時刻として書いてしまいそうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾ったのは公園外の歩道だと伝え、時計を見た帰宅時刻を拾得時刻と間違えそうだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was on the pavement outside the park. I only checked the clock after I got home, so I nearly wrote that as the time I found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found it on the pavement outside the park, and explain that you almost mistook the time you checked on returning home for the finding time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った時刻はわかる範囲で結構です。家に戻った時刻と分けて、推定ならそうお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Just tell us the finding time as far as you know. Keep it separate from the time you got home, and say so if it's an estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩いた記録を見ると、その辺りにいた時間がわかります。正確な分までは不明ですが、この時間帯に拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 歩行記録からその辺りにいた時間帯は分かるが正確な分は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My walking record shows the period when I was in that area. I don't know the exact minute, but I picked it up within this time range.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your walking record shows the time range when you were in the area, but the exact minute is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時間帯として記録します。袋は、拾った時から何か状態が変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record it as a time range. Has the condition of the bag changed at all since you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 拾った時はひもが結ばれていました。そのまま持ってきたので、私は中を見ていません。持ち運ぶ時に外側が少し濡れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ひもが結ばれた状態のまま中を見ず持参し、運ぶ時に外側が少し濡れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The drawstring was tied when I found it. I brought it as it was without looking inside. The outside got a little wet while I was carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought it with the drawstring still tied without looking inside, and the outside became slightly wet during transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態もお伝えいただければ結構です。連絡先と届け出の確認事項を、順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's enough to tell us that condition as well. I'll ask for your contact details and the reporting information in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を記入します。歩道の位置、推定の時間帯、未開封だったこと、運ぶ時に濡れたことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先と歩道の位置、推定時間帯、未開封だった状態、運搬中の濡れを分けて記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill in my contact details. I'll separately explain the location on the pavement, estimated time range, that it was unopened, and that it got wet while I carried it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record your contact details and separately note the pavement location, estimated time range, unopened condition, and wetting during transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで内容を確認します。袋をお届けいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the contents here. Thank you for handing the bag in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで、何を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越した後も前の家に郵便が届いています。住所を変えたのに、転送されないのはなぜでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居後も旧宅へ郵便が届くと伝え、住所を変えたのに転送されない理由を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mail is still arriving at my old home after I moved. I changed my address, so why isn't it being forwarded?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say mail is still reaching your old home after moving, and ask why it is not forwarded despite changing your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで住所変更をされましたか。郵便の転居届を出した控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you change your address? Do you have a record of submitting a postal change-of-address notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通販サイトの登録住所を変えました。それで郵便も全部変わると思っていました。郵便局への届けは出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更したのは通販サイトだけで郵便局へ届出はしていないと説明し、全ての郵便も変わると思っていたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I changed the registered address on a shopping website. I thought that would change all my mail, too. I haven't submitted anything to the post office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only changed a shopping website address and have not notified the post office, and thought all mail would change as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通販の住所変更と郵便の転居届は別です。旧住所、新住所、対象になる方を確認して手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Changing a shopping address and submitting a postal change-of-address notification are separate. We'll explain the procedure after checking your old address, new address, and the people to be covered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私だけが引っ越しました。家族は前の家に残るので、家族宛ての郵便まで移したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分だけが転居し家族は旧宅に残ると説明して、家族宛ては転送しない希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only I have moved. My family is staying at the old home, so I don't want mail addressed to them forwarded as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that only you moved and your family remains at the old home, and say you do not want their mail forwarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居する方の情報を正確にご記入ください。旧住所へ送っている相手にも、個別に新住所を知らせる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter the moving person's details accurately. You'll also need to inform each sender using your old address of your new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 学校からの通知も前の家に届きました。転送の手続きだけで学校の登録住所が変わるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 学校の通知も旧宅へ届いたと伝え、郵便転送と学校の登録変更は別だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: A notice from my school also arrived at my old home. So arranging forwarding doesn't change the address registered with the school, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say a school notice also arrived at the old home and confirm postal forwarding and changing the school's registration are separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、差出人側の住所変更はそれぞれ必要です。届け出の受付方法と反映の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Address changes with each sender are necessary separately. Please also check how to submit the notification and when it takes effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私だけの転居届を出し、学校にも新住所を連絡します。通販、郵便、学校の三つの手続きを分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分だけの転居届と学校への住所連絡を行い、通販、郵便、学校の手続きを分けて確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll submit a change-of-address notification for myself alone and inform my school of the new address, too. I'll check the shopping website, post office, and school procedures separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will submit a notification for yourself alone and inform the school of your address, and check the shopping, postal, and school procedures separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な本人確認と記入事項をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the required identification and form entries. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のお手続きで、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したので登録住所を変えたいです。日中は職場にいるので、住所を職場にしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居で銀行の登録住所を変えたいと伝え、日中いる職場の住所を使ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've moved and want to change my registered address. Since I'm at work during the day, may I use my workplace's address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change your bank's registered address after moving, and ask to use your workplace address where you spend the daytime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お住まいの登録と郵便物の送付については、扱いを分けて確認します。現在住んでいる住所はどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check residence registration and postal delivery separately. What address do you currently live at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この部屋に住んでいます。職場は郵便を受け取りやすいだけです。居住先としては部屋の住所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際に住む部屋を示し職場は郵便を受け取りやすいだけだと説明して、住居には部屋の住所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I live in this room. Work is just more convenient for receiving mail. I'll give the room's address as my residence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show where you actually live, explain that work is only more convenient for receiving mail, and give the room's address as your residence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の住所を確認する書類をご用意いただきます。お持ちの書類の住所は変更済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need documents confirming your current address. Have the addresses on the documents you have been updated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ前の住所の書類があります。携帯の契約住所だけは変えましたが、それだけで銀行の変更に足りるかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類は旧住所のままだと答え、携帯契約の住所変更だけで銀行にも足りるかは不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have documents with my old address. I've only changed my mobile phone contract address, and don't know whether that's enough to change it at the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your documents still have the old address and explain that you do not know whether changing only your phone contract address is enough for the bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類は当行の案内で確認します。書類の更新状況と、郵便物のご希望を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the required documents under our bank's guidance. Please tell the person in charge which documents have been updated and your preferences for postal delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場への送付を希望できるかは別に相談します。まず住居の登録を正しくして、足りない本人確認書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場への送付希望は別に相談し、まず正しい住居登録と必要な本人確認書類を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll discuss the option of having mail sent to work separately. First, I'd like to register my residence correctly and find out which identification documents are missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss delivery to work separately, and first ask about correct residence registration and required identification documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。現住所変更の必要書類と、送付先に関する条件を別々にご説明します。手続きが完了するまでは変更済みと扱わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll explain the documents for a current-address change separately from the conditions for a mailing address. Don't treat the change as completed until the procedure is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住居の住所と送付希望を混ぜずに伝えます。必要書類を揃え、銀行の変更が受け付けられたかまで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 居住住所と送付希望を分け必要書類を揃え、銀行の変更が受け付けられたかまで確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain my residence address and mailing preference separately. I'll gather the required documents and check that the bank has accepted the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate your residence address from your mailing preference, gather the required documents, and check that the bank has accepted the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。新しい住所の情報とお持ちの書類をご用意ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the person in charge. Please have your new address information and the documents you brought ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品について、何をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like me to check about the products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この味付け肉を夕飯に使いたいです。原材料と、帰るまでの保存方法を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕飯用の味付け肉を選びたいと伝え、原材料と帰宅までの保存方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to use this seasoned meat for dinner. Could you tell me the ingredients and how to keep it until I get home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to choose seasoned meat for dinner, and ask about the ingredients and storage until you get home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の表示を確認しましょう。こちらは冷凍の表示があります。ご自宅では冷凍保管できる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the package label. This one is marked frozen. Will you be able to keep it frozen at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 冷蔵品だと思っていました。家の冷凍庫は空いていますが、この後ほかの用事があって、すぐ帰れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷蔵品だと思ったが冷凍表示だったと確認し、冷凍庫は空いているが用事で直帰できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was refrigerated. There's room in my freezer, but I have other errands after this and can't go straight home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the frozen label although you thought it was refrigerated, and explain that your freezer has space but errands prevent you going straight home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入後の保管は商品の表示に従ってください。保冷の手段はありますか。持ち歩ける時間をここで一律に保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please follow the product label for storage after purchase. Do you have a way to keep it cold? We can't guarantee a single carrying time that applies to everyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は保冷バッグがありません。先に買わず、帰る直前に寄りたいです。味が付いていても、そのまま食べられるわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保冷バッグはないので帰宅直前に買うと伝え、味付けだけではそのまま食べられるとは限らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't have an insulated bag today. Rather than buy it now, I'd like to come back just before going home. Even though it's seasoned, that doesn't mean it's ready to eat as it is, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have no insulated bag and will buy just before going home, and confirm seasoning alone does not mean it can be eaten as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この商品の調理表示には加熱が必要とあります。味付けされていても、そのまま食べる商品ではありません。原材料で確認したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The cooking instructions on this product say it must be heated. It's seasoned but isn't a ready-to-eat product. Are there any particular ingredients you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一緒に食べる人が玉ねぎを避けたいと言っています。このたれの原材料に含まれるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同席者が玉ねぎを避けたいと伝え、たれの原材料に含まれるか確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The person eating with me says they want to avoid onions. I'd like to check whether they're in the ingredients of this sauce.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say someone eating with you wants to avoid onions, and you want to check whether they are in the sauce ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品のたれの原材料欄には玉ねぎが記載されています。玉ねぎを避けたい方と食べるなら、この表示を踏まえて選び直してください。ほかの商品も、名前だけで判断せず表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The sauce ingredient list for this product includes onions. If you're eating with someone who wants to avoid onions, please choose again based on this label. Check other products' labels too, rather than judging from their names alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この商品は買いません。玉ねぎを避けられる別の商品について保存と加熱の表示を確認します。先に用事を済ませ、帰る前に保冷の準備をしてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 玉ねぎが含まれるこの商品は買わず、別商品の保存と加熱表示を確認し、用事の後に保冷を準備して選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't buy this product. I'll check the storage and heating labels on another product that allows us to avoid onions. I'll finish my errands first, then prepare a way to keep it cold and choose before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not buy this onion-containing product, will check another product's storage and heating instructions, and will choose after your errands and preparations to keep it cold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入する時にも保存と調理の表示をご確認ください。またお待ちしております。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the storage and cooking labels again when buying. We look forward to seeing you again. Thank you.
